reviews.review:
I cannot recommend this terrible game. The gamebreaking bugs broke the immerson and horror. During my 30-35 minutes playthrough I experienced nothing but frustration rather than horror. Oh there was only 4 horror parts. We saw the creepy janitor once. I didn't get end game either. What was it about? What happened? I'd ratehr not ruin the end game by putting it here.

My first issue was you can softlock yourself out of the game so you have to reload the checkpoint like I had to because there is no inventory system. I was in the bathroom, and Instoad of the developers adding in an invenotry where you pick things up like electic knobs to put in the electric box you have to carry them in front of you 1 by 1 and if you press left click insterad of right click you throw them aross the room or throw them behind the dresser so your then locked out and can't progress as they are stuck. I had to reload the bathroom part 4 times.

There is a scary janitor but no chase and you see him for 2-3 seconds all game and that's it. 
Not very scary. There is another 3-4 jump scares where the lights flash and your protagonist gasps and another where a dead body changes 3-4 times. That's it,, apart from floor blood.

Now we come to the mess hall, electricity on the floor with water. You can't rotate the 5-6 cubes and they block your vision despite zoom out, so I died in the electric water 2-3 times and another time I died because the game reckoned I fell in the electric water when I cleared the water by jumping on the cubes.

What should have taken me 20-30 minutes took me 35-40 minutes. The bugs just ruined the immersion.
Scares? What scares?

Glad I only paid $3-$4 for this game. The bathroom part where I had to reload the game 3-4 times was frustrating just because I pressed the wrong button and threw the electric box knobs under the furniture so I couldn't get them.

Only get this on special otherwise pass on this feeble attemprt at a horror game.
